title: 6 Palworld Pals With Great Partner Skills You Missed | Celaray, Reindrix, Azurmane and More
description: Six Palworld 1.0 Pals with useful partner skills: Celaray (glider), Reindrix (heat resistance mount), Azurmane (air dash), Prixter (poison damage boost), Dogen (teleport home) and Starryon (night mount). Work jobs, wild levels and skills checked on Pindrop, palworld.gg and Pal Breed Calc in November 2026.
joke: You can have the perfect team of six Pals and still lose to a very small Lamball in the wrong place.

sections.heading: Intro
sections.script: Some Pals are famous, and some quietly have a partner skill that makes your whole game easier. In this video we look at six Pals you may have missed: Celaray, Reindrix, Azurmane, Prixter, Dogen and Starryon. For each one you will hear its element, its partner skill, the base work jobs it can do, where in the level range you can find it, and the combat skills it learns. Everything was checked against Pindrop and palworld dot gg, with the wild levels also cross checked on Pal Breed Calc, in Palworld one point zero in November 2026. Skill power numbers come from the lists both sites agree on. Stay until the end for a quick summary of which Pal fits which job. We keep every claim to what the sources agree on, so if a number is missing, it is because the sites did not match.

sections.heading: Celaray partner skill
sections.script: Celaray is a Water Pal with the partner skill Zephyr Glider. While it is in your party, it improves your equipped glider, prevents fall damage and extends high speed gliding. At your base it does Watering and Transporting, both at level one, and in the wild it is very common, with levels from two up to fourteen. For combat, its early skills are Aqua Gun at level seven, which has fifty power and a two second cooldown, and Bubble Blast at level twenty two, with eighty power. Later it learns Hydro Laser at level fifty, with four hundred and fifty power, and Geyser Gush at level seventy, with six hundred power. It is not a top fighter, but it is a very handy travel partner. Because it is so common and so early, it is also an easy first pick for anyone who wants gliding help without waiting for a rare Pal.

sections.heading: Reindrix partner skill
sections.script: Reindrix is an Ice Pal that you can ride. Its partner skill, Cool Body, gives you heat resistance while it is in your party, which helps in hot areas. At your base it works Lumbering and Cooling, both at level three, so it is a good pick for a base with ranch crops and a lot of trees. In the Frostbound Mountains you can find it around levels thirty two to thirty nine. Its skills are Freezing Charge at level twenty two, with one hundred and twenty power, Crystal Breath at level forty, with one hundred and sixty power, Blizzard Spike at level fifty, with four hundred and fifty power, and Diamond Rain at level seventy, with six hundred power. If you need a rideable Ice worker, this is one to remember.

sections.heading: Azurmane partner skill
sections.script: Azurmane is an Electric Pal that you can ride, and its partner skill is Plasma Dash, an air dash that lets you move at even higher speeds. At your base it generates electricity at level five, which is the top level for that job. Wild Azurmane appear around levels sixty three to sixty six, so this is a late game catch. Its skills include All Range Thunder at level thirty, with five hundred power and a twenty four second cooldown, Flash Charge at level forty five, and Bolt Blink at level fifty, with six hundred power and a thirty second cooldown. If you like fast mounts with burst damage, Azurmane is a strong Electric choice, and the air dash helps you cross gaps and escape danger. Since Azurmane is also Electric, it fits a base that needs power, so you can ride it by day and let it generate electricity when you are home.

sections.heading: Prixter partner skill
sections.script: Prixter is a Dark and Earth Pal with the partner skill Phantom Venom. While it is in your party, damage to enemies afflicted with Poison goes up by fifty to sixty five percent, for you and your Pals. That makes it a good partner for poison teams. At your base it does Lumbering at level four, Gathering at level two and Medicine Production at level two, so it can fill several jobs. Wild Prixter appear around levels forty eight to forty nine. It learns Rock Lance at level forty, with four hundred power, Dark Laser at level fifty, with four hundred and fifty power, and Dark Whisp at level seventy, with six hundred power. It is a flexible support Pal that does not take much space on your team.

sections.heading: Dogen partner skill
sections.script: Dogen is a Neutral Pal with the partner skill Homeward Prayer. When you activate it, it teleports you to the nearest base. It cannot be used inside dungeons or similar areas, so plan around that. At your base, Dogen has Handiwork at level four, Gathering, Lumbering and Transporting at level three, and Medicine Production at level two. That is a very wide set of jobs, so it can be a useful base worker too. Wild Dogen appear around levels fifty three to fifty six. In combat it learns Air Blade at level thirty, Wholehearted Stance at level forty, Pal Blast at level fifty, and Holy Burst at level seventy, which has seven hundred power. If you spend a lot of time exploring far from home, this Pal gives you a very useful shortcut back. Do not forget that this teleport has a cooldown, so use it when you really need to get home, not as a replacement for fast travel.

sections.heading: Starryon partner skill
sections.script: Starryon is a Dark Pal that you can ride, and its partner skill is Night Dancer. It boosts your jump power while mounted, and its movement speed goes up by fifty to one hundred percent at night. At your base it is a top Gatherer at level five. In the wild you can find it around levels fifty three to sixty seven. Its combat skills include Dark Ball at level seven, Ignis Rage at level thirty with five hundred power, Spectral Steed at level forty five, and Lethal Step at level fifty, with five hundred and fifty power. Because its speed grows at night, it is best when you ride across the map after dark. For a Dark mount that also works as a strong gatherer, Starryon is a great candidate. Make sure your Pal is rested and fed before a long night ride, so its speed boost keeps up with you across the whole map.

sections.heading: Combat skills compared
sections.script: A quick word about combat skills. Across these six Pals, the late skills are the real power. Celaray and Reindrix both reach six hundred power at level seventy, with Geyser Gush and Diamond Rain. Prixter reaches six hundred with Dark Whisp at level seventy as well, and Dogen goes even higher, with Holy Burst at seven hundred power at level seventy. Azurmane and Starryon reach their top skills earlier, with Bolt Blink at level fifty for six hundred power and Lethal Step at level fifty for five hundred and fifty. Longer cooldowns come with bigger power, so use these skills in the moments that matter, such as the start of a boss fight or when an enemy is about to heal.

sections.heading: Which Pal fits which job
sections.script: Here is the quick summary. If you want a glider upgrade and no fall damage, take Celaray. If you want a rideable Ice worker with heat resistance, take Reindrix. If you want a fast Electric mount with an air dash, take Azurmane. If your team uses poison, take Prixter for the fifty to sixty five percent damage boost. If you often travel far from your base, take Dogen for the teleport home. And if you want a Dark mount that is faster at night and also gathers well, take Starryon. Notice how different the levels are: Celaray is a very early Pal, Reindrix and Prixter appear in the middle, and Azurmane, Dogen and Starryon are later finds. So you can build your collection step by step as you progress through Palworld one point zero.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.script: Let us end with a joke. In Palworld, you can have the perfect team of six Pals, and still be defeated by a very small Lamball standing in the wrong place. Now it is your turn. Which of these six partner skills would help you most, and which Pal should we explain next? Tell us in the comments. If this guide helped you, subscribe to HarryBeast Gaming for more Palworld guides, and we will see you in the next video.
